steps.en: Downloads a Chrome for Testing build pinned to this Puppeteer version
steps.zh: 下载与本版 Puppeteer 锁定的 Chrome for Testing

steps.en: Write a script that launches the browser and opens a page
steps.zh: 写脚本启动浏览器、打开页面

steps.en: Starts Chrome headless and drives it over the DevTools Protocol from a separate process
steps.zh: 以无头模式启动 Chrome，从独立进程经 DevTools 协议驱动

steps.en: Describe the interactions with locators and keyboard or mouse calls
steps.zh: 用定位器和键盘鼠标调用描述要做的交互

steps.en: Waits for each element, fires real user input events, and returns content, screenshots or PDFs
steps.zh: 等元素就绪、触发真实输入事件，返回内容、截图或 PDF

value.en: A real Chrome does the clicking, typing and rendering your script describes, without you speaking the raw browser protocol
value.zh: 一个真正的 Chrome 照你的脚本去点击、输入和渲染，你不用自己去说底层浏览器协议

sources: https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/blob/main/README.md Installation (npm i puppeteer downloads compatible Chrome; npx puppeteer browsers install) and Example (puppeteer.launch, page.goto, page.locator('::-p-aria(Search)').fill)
https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer/blob/main/docs/faq.md (CDP for Chrome, WebDriver BiDi for Firefox; trusted input events; each release bundled with a specific browser)
